consumers.contract: Scores at or above 80 enter enterprise-sales.
Non-customer, non-partner leads below 80 remain in small-business-nurture.
Existing customers below 80 remain in customer-health.
Partner leads below 80 remain in partner-routing.

deployment.scope: All four consumers load the same destination file.
deployment.approval: Enterprise launch request only; no approval to change other consumer routing.
